# Dynamic Drought Module: Architecture & Deployment

## Overview & Repository Documents

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
### Product Scope
- **Dynamic Drought Module (DDM)**: Embeddable, serverless interactive web map.
- **Hazards**: Drought, wildfire, heat, and telemetry indicators across North America.
- **Stewardship**: Built by **ATNI Climate** (Affiliated Tribes of Northwest Indians).
- **Maintenance**: Zero telemetry and zero backend upkeep.
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
### Core Documentation
- [README.md](README.md): Product scope, hazards, iframe embedding.
- [DEVELOPER.md](DEVELOPER.md): Layer contracts, data pipelines, test ladders.
- [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md): Phases, branch posture, decision registers.
- [EXPLAIN_NPM.md](EXPLAIN_NPM.md): Reference guide on npm, Vite, and Pages.
:::
:::

::: {.notes}
DDM is designed so any deployer can host a static copy on standard web infrastructure with zero telemetry and zero backend maintenance.
:::

## The Paradigm: Server-Driven vs. Static Web Apps

Why can a complex mapping application run on **GitHub Pages** without a server?

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
### Server-Driven (Shiny / Streamlit)
- Requires an active **R or Python server** running 24/7.
- Server re-calculates data and re-renders plots on every user interaction.
- Scaling requires provisioning CPU, RAM, and managing worker processes.
- Fails if the server backend crashes.
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
### Static Client-Side (DDM on Pages)
- **Zero application backend**.
- TypeScript is pre-compiled into static HTML, JavaScript, and CSS.
- **Client GPU** renders map vectors via **WebGL** (MapLibre GL JS).
- Hosted cheaply and reliably on GitHub Pages' global CDN.
- Fetches static vector tiles (`.pmtiles`) via HTTP range requests.
:::
:::

## High-Level System Architecture

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    subgraph Dev["Phase 1: Local Build"]
        direction TB
        Src["Source Code<br/>• TypeScript modules<br/>• CSS & Assets"]
        BuildEngine["Node.js + npm + Vite<br/>• tsc typechecks<br/>• Vite bundles & minifies<br/>• Chunks MapLibre & PMTiles"]
        Dist["Production Bundle (dist/)<br/>• index.html (SHA stamp)<br/>• Optimized JS & CSS<br/>• Vector tiles & GeoJSON"]
        Src --> BuildEngine --> Dist
    end

    subgraph Hosting["Phase 2: Pages Hosting"]
        direction TB
        GHA["GitHub Actions (deploy.yml)<br/>• Checks out commit & gates<br/>• Uploads dist/ artifact<br/>• Publishes to Pages"]
        CDN["GitHub Pages CDN<br/>• Global HTTPS hosting<br/>• HTTP Range-request support"]
        GHA --> CDN
    end

    subgraph Client["Phase 3: Client Browser"]
        direction TB
        Browser["Visitor Browser<br/>• Loads HTML, JS, CSS from CDN<br/>• MapLibre GL JS (WebGL GPU)<br/>• Streams .pmtiles on demand<br/>• Public APIs (USGS, NIFC, NOAA)"]
    end

    Dist --> GHA
    CDN --> Browser
```

## Tooling Rosetta Stone: Runtime & Package Management

Coming from Python (`pip`/`conda`) or R (`renv`/`devtools`)? Here is the package management mapping:

| Tool / File | Purpose | Python / R Equivalent | Role in DDM |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Node.js** | JS runtime outside browser | `python3` / `R` runtime | Executes build scripts and tests |
| **`.nvmrc`** | Pins Node version | `pyenv` (`.python-version`) / `.Rversion` | Enforces exact Node **24.20.0** |
| **npm** | Package & script manager | `pip` + `poetry` / `renv` | Manages dependencies & tasks |
| **`package.json`** | Project manifest | `pyproject.toml` / `DESCRIPTION` | Defines metadata, deps & scripts |
| **`package-lock.json`** | Cryptographic lockfile | `poetry.lock` / `renv.lock` | Guarantees exact dependency tree |
| **`npm ci`** | Deterministic install | `pip install --no-deps` / `renv::restore()` | Clean install strictly from lockfile |

## Tooling Rosetta Stone: Build & Testing Engines

Mapping compilation, bundling, and browser automation to familiar ecosystems:

| Tool / File | Purpose | Python / R Equivalent | Role in DDM |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **TypeScript** | Static type checking | `mypy` / Type annotations | Catches type bugs at build time |
| **Vite** | Dev server & bundler | Webpack / Quarto (`pkgdown`) | Fast HMR & production bundler |
| **Playwright** | Browser automation | `pytest-playwright` / `shinytest2` | Headless browser integration tests |

::: {.callout-tip}
### Web Tooling Philosophy
Just as `renv.lock` guarantees R environment reproducibility across collaborators, `package-lock.json` and `.nvmrc` eliminate "works on my machine" differences in modern web applications.
:::

## Core Configuration: `.nvmrc` & `package.json`

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
### 1. Node LTS & Dependencies
- **Pinned Version (`.nvmrc`)**:
  - Pins Node `24.20.0` (Active LTS).
  - Enforced in local shells (`nvm use`) and CI (`actions/setup-node`).

- **Runtime Dependencies (`package.json`)**:
  - `maplibre-gl`: WebGL mapping engine.
  - `pmtiles`: Cloud-optimized vector tile reader.
  - `@preact/signals`: Fine-grained reactive UI state.
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
### 2. Key npm Task Scripts
- **`npm run dev`**:
  - Local Vite dev server with instant HMR at `http://localhost:5173`.
- **`npm run build`**:
  - Static typecheck (`tsc`) and bundle to `dist/`.
- **`npm run preview`**:
  - Serves `dist/` bundle locally at `http://localhost:4173`.
- **`npm run gate`**:
  - Comprehensive gate: builds, budgets, contracts, and tests.
:::
:::

## Bundling & Optimization: `vite.config.ts`

Key architectural decisions configured in `vite.config.ts`:

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
### Relative URLs & Stamping
- **Relative Asset URLs (`base: './'`)**:
  - Runs seamlessly at domain root, on Pages subpaths (`/dynamic-drought-module/`), or inside an `<iframe>`.
- **Build Stamping (`DDM_BUILD_SHA`)**:
  - Embeds Git SHA & nonce into the DOM.
  - Allows tests and monitoring to verify the live commit.
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
### Vendor Chunk Splitting
- **Cache Isolation**:
  - Isolates `maplibre-gl` (~800 kB) and `pmtiles` into separate vendor chunks.
- **Client Cache Preservation**:
  - Daily app code updates do not re-download unchanged geospatial engines.
- **Tree-Shaking**:
  - Dead code elimination strips unused dependencies from production bundle.
:::
:::

## Local Developer Verification Ladder

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="49%"}
### Verification Ladder
```bash
# 1. Clean installation matching lockfile
npm ci

# 2. Interactive dev with instant HMR
npm run dev

# 3. Fast syntax & typecheck (~5s)
npm run verify:quick

# 4. Deterministic quality gate (~40s)
npm run gate

# 5. Full serial browser test suite
npm run test:serial
```
:::

::: {.column width="49%"}
### Quality Principles
- **Local-First Verification**:
  - Catch errors before pushing to avoid broken CI.
- **Tiered Feedback Loops**:
  - Fast feedback (`verify:quick`), deep gating (`gate`).

::: {.callout-note}
### The Gate Rule
Always run `npm run gate` before pushing. It validates bundle sizes, budgets, and schema contracts.
:::
:::
:::

## GitHub Actions Deployment Pipeline

The workflow in `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` orchestrates builds and deployments on pushes to `main`:

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    Push["Push to 'main' Branch<br/>(paths-ignore docs)"] --> Concurrency["Concurrency Gate<br/>group: pages"]

    subgraph DeployWorkflow["deploy.yml (GitHub Actions)"]
        direction TB
        subgraph BuildJob["Job: build (Gate & Build)"]
            direction TB
            Setup["Set up Node 24.20.0<br/>& npm ci"]
            Gate["npm run gate<br/>• tsc typecheck<br/>• vite build (dist/)<br/>• Budgets & tests"]
            UploadArtifact["actions/upload-pages-artifact<br/>(Publish package)"]
            Setup --> Gate --> UploadArtifact
        end

        subgraph DeployJob["Job: deploy (Pages)"]
            direction TB
            HeadCheck["Confirm HEAD of main"]
            DeployPages["actions/deploy-pages<br/>• Write to CDN (30s retry)"]
            HeadCheck --> DeployPages
        end

        subgraph BrowserJob["Job: browser (Advisory)"]
            direction TB
            Playwright["Playwright Browser Suite<br/>• 8 parallel shards<br/>• Advisory on main"]
        end

        BuildJob -->|needs: build| DeployJob
        BuildJob -.->|parallel advisory| BrowserJob
    end

    subgraph VerifyWorkflow["verify-live.yml (Post-Deploy Proof)"]
        direction TB
        LiveProof["Probe Live Site<br/>• SHA & nonce match<br/>• PMTiles byte-range (206)<br/>• Live browser smoke tests<br/>• File divergence on fail"]
    end

    Concurrency --> BuildJob
    DeployJob ==>|triggers on success| VerifyWorkflow
```

## Release Evidence & Live Verification

In DDM, **a merged commit is not proof of a successful release**.

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
### 1. Proof of Live Deployment
- **Build Nonce & SHA Check**:
  - Probes live DOM `dataset.ddmBuildSha`.
  - Confirms the CDN actively serves the exact commit, not a stale cache.
- **Byte-Range Capability**:
  - Asserts HTTP `206 Partial Content` on `.pmtiles`.
  - Ensures global CDN supports streaming tile slices without downloading entire archives.
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
### 2. Runtime Integrity & Alerting
- **Live Browser Smoke Boots**:
  - Headless browser boots against production URL.
  - Validates initial view state, embed mode, and real-time layer loading.
- **Automated Issue Triage**:
  - Automatically files or updates a tracked GitHub issue if live site diverges from commit HEAD.
:::
:::

## Summary & Next Steps

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
### Summary of Principles
- **Serverless & Embeddable**: Pure static files running on standard CDNs.
- **Local-First Verification**: Fast feedback loops before code ever hits Git.
- **Sovereign Stewardship**: Real-time sovereign boundaries fetched live in browser sessions, never stored or redistributed.
- **Empirical Release Evidence**: Automated verification of live CDN bytes.
:::
